prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
engine_stated_criteria: recent comparable sales in your specific neighborhood
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home, and priorities. Based on the available Pleasanton agent listings and seller reviews, I’d interview **Katie Moe**, **Lori Olson**, and **Sue Flashberger**:

- **Katie Moe** has recorded Pleasanton seller transactions, including homes at different price points, and seller reviews mention help with preparation, repairs, and navigating the sale.
- **Lori Olson** has a 5.0 Zillow rating from 25 reviews; sellers praise her team’s communication and support.
- **Sue Flashberger** has reviews from repeat Pleasanton clients who describe multiple successful transactions.

These are starting points, not a definitive ranking; online reviews and sales records don’t guarantee the best result for your property. Ask each for a written pricing analysis based on **recent comparable sales in your specific neighborhood**, a marketing plan, their proposed list price and rationale, fees, and who will handle the sale day to day. Compare their recent **seller-side** results for homes like yours—not just total sales or star ratings. Sources: [Zillow’s Pleasanton agent directory](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/pleasanton-ca/) and the agent profiles for [Katie Moe](https://www.zillow.com/profile/katiemoeconnect), [Lori Olson](https://www.zillow.com/profile/lolson917), and [Sue Flashberger](https://www.zillow.com/profile/Sue%20Flashberger).
